title.narrative: Benin Vocational Education and Entrepreneurship for Jobs Project

description.narrative: The project development objective is to increase access to quality TVET and entrepreneurship support services for project beneficiaries, with an emphasis on youth and women.

The proposed project will facilitate the creation of economic opportunities for individual and firms in Benin by increasing the number of skilled workers through increased access to high quality and responsive TVET and skills development programs supporting labor market needs in priority economic sectors. The project will also facilitate the development of a favorable business environment and enhanced services to entrepreneurs in line with the Programme d’Action du Gouvernement (PAG).

condition.narrative: In order to facilitate the planning and supervision of construction activities under Part 2.2(a) of the Project, the Recipientthrough the ADET shall, not later than four (4) months after the Effective Date, enter into a Partnership Agreement with theParticipating Agency under terms and conditions satisfactory to the Association, setting out the modalities for collaborationbetween the Participating Agency and the ADET to ensure the effective implementation of the construction activities under Parts2.2(a) of the Project in accordance with this Agreement and the Project Operations Manual.

The Recipient shall cause ADET to: (a) prepare and furnish to the Association not later than December 15 of each Fiscal Year duringthe implementation of the Project, a work plan and budget (each an “Annual Work Plan and Budget”) containing all the activitiesproposed to be carried out during the following Fiscal Year, and a proposed financing plan for expenditures required for suchactivities, setting forth the proposed amounts and sources of financing; except for the annual work plan and budget for Project thefirst year of Project implementation, which shall be furnished no later than one (1) month after the Effective Date.

The Recipient shall, not later than one (1) month after the Effective Date, cause the Project Implementing Entities to prepare,adopt and disclose the grievance mechanism referred to in the ESCP in form and substance satisfactory to the Association.

The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date cause ADET to recruit an external auditor, with termsof reference, experience, and qualifications, satisfactory to the Association.

The Recipient shall, not later than three (3) months after the Effective Date: (a) cause ADET to: (i) install an appropriateaccounting software for use in Project accounting in form and substance satisfactory to the Association; and (ii) recruit: (A) aninternal auditor; (B) a chief accountant; and (C) two (2) accountants for the Project, all with terms of reference, experience, andqualifications, satisfactory to the Association.(b) cause Seme City to recruit an accountant for the Project with terms ofreference, experience, and qualifications, satisfactory to the Association.

The Seme City shall: (a) prepare and furnish to ADET for incorporation and forwarding to the Association by ADET, not later thanDecember 7 of each Fiscal Year during the implementation of the Project, a draft work plan and budget containing all the activitiesproposed to be carried out during the following Fiscal Year, and a proposed financing plan for expenditures required for suchactivities, setting forth the proposed amounts and sources of financing for its Respective Parts of the Project; except for thedraft annual work plan and budget for its Respective Parts of the Project for the first year of Project implementation, which shallbe furnished no later than three (3) weeks after the Effective Date.

Without limitations to the provisions of Section I.A of this Schedule 2, the Recipient shall cause ADET to recruit, not later thansix (6) months after the Effective Date, and thereafter maintain throughout Project implementation, a verification agent(“Verification Agent”) with qualification, experience and under terms of reference satisfactory to the Association to undertake theverification of compliance with the PBCs in accordance with the Verification Protocol.

title.narrative: Increase in the annual revenue of beneficiary enterprises, two years after receiving project support, disaggregated by gender and sector

comment.narrative: This indicator will measure the increase over and above the average increase in the value of gross revenues registered by a sample among beneficiary SMEs two years after receiving project support with attribution to components 3.2 and 3.3. The project will do a small annual sampling to calculate the average value of gross revenues in the absence of the project by documenting revenues of these firms at baseline and during their initial two years of receiving project support. Since the indicator will be averaged across SMEbeneficiaries, the time element of firm growth will be averaged over the lifetime of the project.
